visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Label that is not connected
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Tapping the word "Phone" does not focus the phone input, and a screen reader reads the input as an unnamed field. The label and the input are not connected.

solution.explanation: The for attribute of a label must equal the id of its input. When they differ, the label is just text. A connected label gives a bigger tap target and a name for screen readers.

checks.label: The phone input has a label
The label belongs to the phone input
